title: pentacalia epidendra
intro: Pentacalia epidendra, commonly known as the Golden Scales or Golden Shield, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is a member of the Asteraceae family and is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Pentacalia epidendra include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant actions, which may contribute to its therapeutic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified as responsible for its therapeutic actions.
